NeoPlayer needs storage access to automatically index videos, music, and subtitles on your device for a seamless playback experience. All processing is kept strictly local.
NeoPlayer strictly adheres to privacy standards. The requested permission is used exclusively for scanning and playing local media:
Be rest assured, your privacy is our utmost priority, and we neither access your files for other purposes nor transfer or store them to our servers. They remain safe on your device.
On Android 13 and above, this permission allows the app to read video files from your device\'s storage, including Downloads, Movies, and DCIM folders.
This permission allows the app to read media files from your device\'s storage to play videos and audio.
NeoPlayer needs access to your video files to provide its core functionality as a media player.
The permission is used exclusively for:
• Discovering and displaying your video files\n• Playing media content\n• Loading subtitle files
Please know that this permission is only used for the auto-discovery of media/subtitle files on your device and will not allow us to access the private data files stored by other apps in any way.
NeoPlayer has always required storage access permission as it\'s essential for the app to find all media and subtitle files on your device, including the ones that are not supported by the system.
However, due to a change in security policy, apps built for Android 11 and above now require additional permission to continue accessing the same.

In \"User Management\", ensure the WebDAV permission is enabled for your user, otherwise players cannot list your cloud drives.

Add local WebDAV (http://127.0.0.1:5244/dav) in NeoPlayer network sources to stream smoothly. Other devices on your home Wi-Fi (Smart TV / Media Players / PC) can also stream using this phone\'s LAN IP address.

OpenList is a powerful local cloud storage aggregator and streaming gateway (like Rclone, but with a built-in visual web dashboard). It unifies popular cloud storage services and network protocols (Google Drive, OneDrive, SMB, WebDAV, etc.) into a local WebDAV service, with continuous expansions.

• Zero Terminal & No Root: Configure cloud drives directly through an intuitive Web dashboard.\n• 100% Local & Private: Runs entirely on localhost:5244. Your credentials and tokens are stored safely in local sandbox and never transmitted to third parties.\n• High-Performance Streaming: Native WebDAV gateway optimized for direct 4K video playback.
